key_value_text.quote: The lower limits on the partial lifetime for the various nucleon decay modes range from 5.4X 103o yr for p ~ t - n + K + to 1.0× 1032 yr for p n ~ e + n
key_value_text.value: Partial-lifetime lower limits from 5.4e30 years up to 1.0e32 years across the (B-L)-violating and di-nucleon channels (2.0 kt yr exposure)

name: Lifetime limits on (B-L)-violating nucleon decay and di-nucleon decay modes from the Fréjus experiment

significance.quote: Lower limits on the nucleon lifetime at 90% CL

summary.plain: Looking at 153 fully contained events, the Fréjus experiment saw no sign of exotic nucleon decays that change baryon number and lepton number together, nor of two nucleons decaying at once, and set lifetime limits for 39 channels.
summary.technical: Fully contained events (2.0 kt yr exposure, 700 t fiducial) searched for B-L-violating nucleon decay and di-nucleon decay: no signal, lower partial-lifetime limits at 90% CL for 35 channels with a visible particle plus limits on neutron and di-neutron decay to neutrinos.

title: Lifetime limits on (B-L)-violating nucleon decay and di-nucleon decay modes from the Fréjus experiment
why_it_matters: Extended the baryon-number-violation limits to decay modes that unified models such as SO(10) allow but minimal SU(5) forbids.
